Type: acceptance gate
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: O02
Accountable role (person unassigned): Operations engineer with institutional operator
Pilot scope: required

Outcome: Operators see and can respond to resource exhaustion, failed work and unavailable dependencies before data stewardship fails.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Provide distinct liveness/readiness including the closed recovery gate, redacted structured diagnostics, authorized audit inspection, useful metrics and tested alert delivery.
2. Account for accepted/staged/abandoned/backup storage; enforce capacity reservations and bounded queues/concurrency, including streaming response lifetimes and large inventory responses.
3. Exercise database outage, disk-full, failed/abandoned imports and cancellation; document escalation, safe service behavior and integrity scrub/repair procedures without enabling unqualified garbage collection.

Review all child evidence against these integration criteria. Children closing does not automatically close this gate. Required human/institutional evidence must be observed, never inferred from automated tests.
